faq.a: Isah is associated with the Arabic form عِيسَى, whose core sense is isah; jesus (prophet) (hausa form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Isah?
faq.a: Isah is associated with Arabic. Isah is the Hausa form of Arabic عِيسَى (ʿĪsā), the Quranic form of the prophet Jesus.
Yes — the underlying form عِيسَى is Arabic.
Isah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Isah should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿĪsā is the Quranic Arabic form of the prophet Jesus and occurs in the Quran.

faq.q: What does Isah mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Isah is rendered عیسیٰ and carries the sense عیسیٰ، نبی کا نام.

faq.q: What does Isah mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Isah is rendered عیسی and carries the sense عیسی، نام پیامبر.
A romanized syllable approximation is i-sah. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Isah?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Isah, isah. Script forms are عيسى, عِيسَى, عیسی, عیسیٰ, ईसा.

faq.q: Is Isah a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
